description_full: Somnigroup International Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, distributes, and retails bedding products in the United States and internationally. It provides mattresses, foundations and adjustable foundations, and adjustable bases, as well as other products comprising pillows and other accessories under the Tempur-Pedic, Sealy, Stearns & Foster, and Sleepy's brands. The company operates a portfolio of retail brands, including Mattress Firm, Dreams, Tempur-Pedic retail stores, and SOVA; and licenses Sealy, Tempur, and Stearns & Foster brands, as well as technology and trademarks to other manufacturers. It sells its products through company-owned stores, online, and call centers; and third-party retailers, including third party distribution, hospitality, and healthcare. The company was formerly known as Tempur Sealy International, Inc. and changed its name to Somnigroup International Inc. in February 2025. The company was founded in 1846 and is based in Dallas, Texas.

financial_summary: Somnigroup International Inc. is a large-cap consumer cyclical business with a $14.8B market cap on $7.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +15% over the past three years and +9% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 17% against a 9% cost of capital, a 8-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, with gross margins sitting at 43%.

The business throws off $633M in free cash flow — roughly 8 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.08× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 4.4× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 2.8× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.5%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 3.1% of the shares.
